skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding Basic Concepts of Critical Thinking
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand fundamental concepts of critical thinking including knowledge, skills, and attitudes.
Demonstrate awareness of the importance of critical thinking and argument construction in speaking and writing.
Identify and analyze the structure of arguments.
Distinguish between deductive and inductive arguments and their subtypes.
Comprehend how speakers and writers construct arguments.
Recognize and analyze logical fallacies in arguments.
Evaluate the validity and strength of arguments.
Identify and avoid ambiguities in thinking when speaking and writing.
Identify persuasive elements in arguments such as ethos, pathos, and logos.
Apply persuasive techniques to construct convincing arguments in speaking and writing.
Participate in debates on current topics.
Write argumentative essays defending personal viewpoints.
Formulate critical questions about real-life issues.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Applying Critical Thinking to Solve Practical Problems
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Use critical thinking to solve practical problems.
Demonstrate teamwork skills such as cooperation, task allocation, effective communication, and conflict resolution.
Articulate and defend personal views based on objective and scientific approaches.
Consistently practice critical thinking through exercises in textbooks, group assignments, and daily life.
